label.purpose: Field labels, counts, tags; sentence case.

shadows.name: soft-lift-native
shadows.purpose: Light-mode white surface cards (native). None in dark mode.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action; yellow with ink label.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #ffc21a; color: #14171a; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1.5px solid transparent; border-radius: 14px; font-family: Barlow, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity .15s, transform .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: .92; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: .85; transform: scale(.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #14171a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #14171a; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1.5px solid #85898d; border-radius: 14px; font-family: Barlow, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(.98); opacity: .85; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #14171a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Option Chip
components.description: Radio pill; selected state fills yellow.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1.5px solid #dcdad1; background: #f5f4ef; color: #14171a; font-family: Barlow, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #e6e4dc; } .ds-chip-on { background: #ffc21a; border-color: #14171a; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Large numeric input with unit affix.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: Barlow, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; color: #51575d; } .ds-field-wrap { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 14px; background: #fff; border: 1.5px solid #85898d; border-radius: 14px; } .ds-field-wrap:focus-within { border: 2px solid #14171a; } .ds-field input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; font-family: Barlow, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 20px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #14171a; } .ds-field em { font-style: normal; font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; margin-left: 6px; }

components.name: Work Card
components.description: Home work-section entry with yellow icon tile.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; min-height: 96px; padding: 16px; background: #fff; border-radius: 20px; font-family: Barlow, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,23,26,.06), 0 4px 12px rgba(20,23,26,.05); color: #14171a; } .ds-card:hover { background: #e6e4dc; } .ds-card strong { display: block; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-card small { font-size: 13px; color: #51575d; } .ds-tile { width: 60px; height: 60px; border-radius: 18px; background: #ffc21a; }

components.name: Tab Bar Item
components.description: Bottom tab; active shows yellow pill.
components.css: .ds-tab { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 3px; min-height: 56px; font-family: Barlow, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; color: #14171a; } .ds-pill { width: 64px; height: 32px; border-radius: 16px; background: #ffc21a; }

components.name: Adjusted Tag
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #ffefc7; color: #7a4b00; font-family: Barlow, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; }

narrative.overview: Buildcalc looks and handles like equipment, not a worksheet. Job-site yellow is the single loud voice, set against a charcoal masthead and warm concrete-grey ground. Inputs and targets are oversized for one-handed, gloved use outdoors; the live total travels with the thumb instead of sitting at the foot of a document. This build replaces the earlier flat, square, no-shadow ruled-paper "Site Fieldbook" world.
keyCharacteristics: Yellow (#ffc21a) is the action and selection color; charcoal is the anchor surface.
Barlow Condensed for display and numeric figures, Barlow for everything else.
10/14/20px radii with pill chips; softly lifted white cards on warm grey.
One stenciled-line icon family (BuildcalcIcon), placed in rounded icon tiles.
Light and dark schemes, both first-class.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Yellow marks what you can act on or what is selected. It never decorates; on white it is a fill with dark ink, never a text color. Yellow text appears only on charcoal.

rules.name: The Ink-On-Yellow Rule
rules.body: Every yellow fill takes #14171a text or icon.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Any number a user compares or sums (quantities, pesos, totals) uses tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Soft-Lift Rule
rules.body: Only white surface cards lift, and only softly and in light mode. No hard offset shadows; no glow.

dos: Do keep primary targets at 56px (chips 48px) and make yellow the only action color.
Do put ink on every yellow fill and use tabular figures for all numbers.
Do build new surfaces from Screen, Card, Txt variants, Button, Field, Options, Tag, IconTile in src/components/ui/kit.tsx; read colors through useColors, never hard-code hex.
Do design every surface for both light and dark schemes.
Do use BuildcalcIcon stencil icons at 20-24px, inside tiles for section identity.
donts: Don't return to the flat, square, no-shadow ruled-paper look; corners below 10px and document-with-tabs layouts are off-system.
Don't use yellow as text on light surfaces or as a decorative accent.
Don't add hard offset shadows, glows, or shadows in dark mode.
Don't introduce a third typeface or system display faces.
Don't add unicode or emoji glyph icons.
